title.from: L0: Generate Emotion labeler comments live (gpt-6-luna, cap ~500 calls)
title.to: Optional L0: generate simulated stakeholder comments (gpt-6-luna, cap ~500 calls)

description.from:
## Purpose

Produce the labeler explanations that feed A-c.

## Scope

OpenAI gpt-6-luna with the S5 style over the ~450 pool labels (3 x 150); text-free storage of outputs.

## Request bound and cost cap

~450 labels; cap ~500 calls. Cap: < $0.50. Fresh ledger for this stage; gate needs `--max-new-requests` >= printed bound and <= ceiling; circuit breaker on; failures tallied by error class. Counts toward the hard cumulative cap of $10.

## Stop-point checks

Comment present on most items; spot-check a few for invented rules.

## Definition of done

Comments cached for all rounds; actual calls and spend recorded here.

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)

## Purpose

OPTIONAL, after the labels-only stages (L3). Generate SIMULATED stakeholder explanations (S5 style; the model knows the gold label) that feed A-c in L5. Owner clarification (2026-10-01): a static labeled dataset has no stakeholder explanations; explanations are how stakeholders communicate a rubric by example over time. Reported as simulated, never as a property of the dataset.
